summary: Last action of the window, and the same shape as the two before it because that is what can be verified in seconds: I recorded the third durable finding as knowledge. Where the singleton shortcut does not apply - a still-leading but removed node whose configuration has more than one voter - the request is taken into readOnly and answered only if the round completes; when the leadership ends, whatever it accepted is gone with no ReadState, nothing pending or unconfirmed, and no refusal signalled, so an application that treats acceptance as a promise waits out its own deadline while one that retries unconditionally recovers. The entry cites the shortcut, the read-only round, the heartbeat-response path, the proposal-refusal guard and the Node.ReadIndex contract, with events 1-5 of check 79d6bcb6. Validation reports valid with a knowledge entry created. Together with the two entries from the previous turns, the three findings that outlive the prose - the replacement-leader condition for the end of the exposure, the forwarded answer consumed as another node's read state, and the accepted-then-lost request - now sit as reviewable knowledge alongside the Q1 and Q2 accounts.
